documents.instruction: Keep the three-part mental model (run loop, jailed tools, local ledgers), the ownership boundaries (Brama routes, Skarbiec rotates, Stado places, Pursuit owns autonomy), and every quoted refusal true to rust/.
The build commands, required environment, /setup behavior, and failure pointers must stay executable against the current source; bin/jeden-rust bootstrap rules come from the script itself.
Session directory layout, transcript.jsonl ledger guarantees, usage.json and mode-state.json shapes must match the Rust writers exactly.
Banner, method table, session options, event kinds, interaction bridge, and every error code and sentence must match rust/rpc/server.rs and interaction.rs verbatim.
Brama catalog resolution, HMAC signing, credential precedence, and the run-with-stado credential rule must match the source; never name real endpoints or credentials.

Env-file load order, config layer precedence, every key in SETTINGS_SCHEMA with type and default, file-only keys, and the exact jeden config refusal sentences must match rust/cli/config/schema.rs and mod.rs.
Every command, flag, output shape, exit code, and quoted error sentence must match the parser and dispatch in rust/main.rs and the per-command modules.
The jeden.session.v1 wire contract, mTLS admission rules, tenant limits, error-code table, and quoted refusals must match rust/rpc; keep the startup-panic note accurate for the built revision.
Every symptom entry quotes the exact error string the source produces; retry classes, delays, fallback reasons, and cooldown semantics must match model_router.rs.
Executed walkthrough: every pasted refusal, exit code, ledger event type, and doctor probe must reproduce against the documented build via the companion script.
Executed walkthrough: show/export/search/resume output and the torn-tail recovery contract must reproduce against the documented build via the companion script.
Definition, state.json shape, lifecycle, and invariants of a session must match the Rust session store.
Envelope fields, sealing, checksum rules, and refusal sentences must match rust/session/event.rs.
Append-only guarantees, validation on read, truncated-tail recovery, and every quoted refusal must match rust/session/store.rs.
Outbox seeding and delivery semantics must match the session source.
Every ModeState field with serde name and default, the lock-file protocol, and its exact error strings must match rust/slash/state.rs.
usage.json event shape, pricing fields, and billing target recording must match the usage writer.
Capability registry semantics and the captured jeden capabilities output must match the source.
Tenant isolation, limits, and quota refusals must match the headless facade in rust/rpc.
The strict JSON action contract must match rust/protocol.rs and the published schema.
